facts.en: Completed a diploma in Operations Administration at Fictional Institute D077 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D077 完成运营行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a warehouse records clerk at Fictional Goods Cooperative D077 from 2021-09 to 2023-12.
facts.zh: 2021-09 至 2023-12 在虚构商品合作社 D077 担任仓库记录文员。

facts.en: Transferred within that employer to replenishment administration from 2024-01 to 2026-08, with no overlap between the paid roles.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在该雇主内部转任补货行政岗位，两份有偿岗位无重叠。

facts.en: The earlier role recorded receipts and escalated stock-count variances to a stock controller.
facts.zh: 早期岗位记录收货，并将库存盘点差异上报库存管理员。

facts.en: In replenishment administration, maintained purchase-order due dates and planner-approved reorder lists.
facts.zh: 在补货行政岗位维护采购订单到期日期及计划员批准的补货清单。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet lookups to match item codes across open orders and warehouse receipts.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格查找，将未完成订单与仓库收货中的商品编码匹配。

facts.en: With a planner, reviewed 110 open order lines during 2025-04 to identify stale delivery dates.
facts.zh: 在 2025-04 与计划员合作，复查 110 条未完成订单明细，识别过期交货日期。

facts.en: The team confirmed updated dates for 18 of 23 flagged lines; 5 stayed unresolved and were marked pending in the planning sheet.
facts.zh: 团队为标出的 23 条明细中的 18 条确认更新日期；5 条仍未解决，在计划表中标为待定。

facts.en: This review improved date documentation only; no stockout reduction or inventory-cost saving was measured.
facts.zh: 该复查仅改善日期记录；未测量缺货减少或库存成本节省。

facts.en: Coordinated a 2026-01 trial of a weekly exception list for 2 product groups, reviewed by the planner.
facts.zh: 在 2026-01 协调 2 个商品组的每周异常清单试用，由计划员审阅。

facts.en: Contacted suppliers for status updates using buyer-approved messages; buyers changed purchase commitments.
facts.zh: 使用采购员批准的消息向供应商询问状态；采购员变更采购承诺。

facts.en: Drafted a demand-forecast template in 2026-05 using fictional seasonal sales; it was never used for operational orders.
facts.zh: 2026-05 使用虚构季节性销售数据起草需求预测模板；从未用于运营订单。

facts.en: Completed a 2025-08 planning course exercise on moving averages with 36 fictional monthly observations.
facts.zh: 2025-08 完成计划课程中的移动平均练习，使用 36 个虚构月度观测值。

facts.en: The coursework is not evidence of independently owning a production demand forecast.
facts.zh: 该课程作业不能证明独立负责生产需求预测。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 seasonal peak, tracked 14 suppliers; the regular 2026-08 list held 8.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 季节高峰期跟踪 14 家供应商；2026-08 常规名单有 8 家。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Sports Kit Exchange V077 from 2024-02 to 2024-07 on evenings while employed.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2024-07 任职期间，晚间在虚构运动用品交换团体 V077 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the exchange, labeled donated kit by size rather than forecasting demand or purchasing stock.
facts.zh: 为交换团体按尺码标记捐赠用品，而非预测需求或采购库存。

facts.en: Built a personal model harbor in 2022 using recycled cardboard; it was not a logistics simulation.
facts.zh: 2022 年用回收纸板制作个人港口模型；并非物流仿真。

facts.en: Keeps a bird-call listening journal unrelated to supply planning.
facts.zh: 保留与供应计划无关的鸟鸣聆听日记。

facts.en: Prepared handover notes separating confirmed supplier dates from estimates awaiting confirmation.
facts.zh: 准备交接记录，区分已确认供应商日期与待确认估计日期。

facts.en: An appraisal draft says inventory fell by 30%, but the attached sheet measures open-order line count rather than inventory value or units.
facts.zh: 一份考评草稿称库存减少 30%，但附表衡量未完成订单明细数量，而非库存价值或数量单位。

facts.en: No authority to set safety stocks, approve supplier contracts or own the forecasting model is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录设定安全库存、批准供应商合同或负责预测模型的权限。
